verifications.note: Verified via pdftotext of the downloaded PDF (Pipeline & Gas Journal 'PN1018 Planned Projects', Oct. 2018), MOUNTAINEER GAS CO. entry: 'Operator: Mountaineer Gas Co. / Project: Mountaineer Gas Pipeline Phase I / Type: Project includes pipeline construction / Length: 27.5 miles / Diameter: 10 inches / Location: Berkley, VA - Martinsburg, WV / Cost: $45 million / Docket: 15-1256-G-390P / Completion: 2Q 2019' — names the pipeline and Phase I segment directly and states the exact recorded termini verbatim (Berkley, VA start / Martinsburg, WV end).

'The first calls for building a 27.5-mile distribution trunk line, beginning at a new interconnection in Morgan County, WV, with a new transmission line from Columbia Gas Transmission LLC (CGT) and extending to the northern end of the company's distribution system, which serves the area of Martinsburg, WV.' Confirms Martinsburg, WV as the end point and the 27.5-mile length, but places the START point in Morgan County, WEST VIRGINIA (not Virginia) — see researcher_notes.

resolutions.researcher_notes: EndLocation='Martinsburg'/EndState='West Virginia' is solidly corroborated by both sources plus wvpress.org and wvpublic.org (already open on this row for other columns), which independently describe Phase I as running to/from 'the northern end of the company's distribution system... Martinsburg, WV.' StartLocation='Berkley'/StartState='Virginia' is sourced verbatim to the Pipeline & Gas Journal PN1018 trade digest ('Location: Berkley, VA - Martinsburg, WV') — this is almost certainly the actual origin of the sheet's recorded value, so citing it as REFS_ADDED with the SAME value per the corollary-(e) rule. FLAGGING A CONTRADICTION FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR: every other independent source describing this same 27.5-mile first segment places its origin in WEST VIRGINIA, not Virginia — NaturalGasIntel: 'a new interconnection in Morgan County, WV, with a new transmission line from [CGT]'; WV Press Association (wvpress.org, already cited on this row): '...a 22-mile line from the end of the existing system just north of Martinsburg to Berkeley Springs' / 'the Martinsburg-to-Berkeley Springs extension'; WV Public Broadcasting (wvpublic.org, already cited on this row): 'a 27-mile distribution line would run from a Columbia Gas transmission line in Pennsylvania to Berkeley Springs and then onto the north end of Martinsburg.' Berkeley Springs is the seat of Morgan County, WEST VIRGINIA (not Virginia, and not Berkeley County). No source found places any 'Berkley' in the Commonwealth of Virginia on this pipeline's route, and no independent source repeats the PN1018 PDF's 'VA' state code. Best read: PN1018's 'Berkley, VA' is a trade-digest transcription error for 'Berkeley Springs, WV' (or possibly Berkeley County, WV) that the sheet's recorded StartLocation/StartState appear to have inherited verbatim — recommend the orchestrator route a StartState/Province correction from 'Virginia' to 'West Virginia' (and consider StartLocation 'Berkley' -> 'Berkeley Springs') for human review; left unchanged here since this unit is scoped to sourcing Location [ref], not editing the value.
